findings.title: Israel Kills 16 Palestinians, Including Two Women and a Child, and Continues to Destroy Remaining Homes in Gaza
findings.event_time: 11:00 Palestine local time (approximate; reported by PCHR)
findings.location: Fattouh Street near al-Sikkah Street, al-Zaytoun neighborhood, east Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Dozens of families reportedly displaced after drone-dropped explosive charges destroyed residential houses and tents; no casualties reported in this incident.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: This forced dozens of families to flee the area without having time to retrieve their belongings.
findings.source_type: Independent Palestinian human rights NGO; primary field-research documentation

bounded_discovery_context.classification_detail: Late-recalled, independently documented incident from 13 Nov, described in PCHR's 16 Nov publication; NOT a casualty or displacement incident occurring in the present hour.
bounded_discovery_context.unique_feature: Reported deliberate drone drops of explosive-laden boxes onto homes in al-Zaytoun with forced displacement of dozens of families, distinguishable from 6–9 Nov storm displacement and known 16 Nov casualty cases.
bounded_discovery_context.prior_deduplication: Previous completed heartbeat and 15:44/10:44 checkpoints reviewed; this al-Zaytoun explosive-charge displacement case was not described in those ledgers. Does not establish full production collector coverage.
bounded_discovery_context.source_evidence: PCHR names Fattouh/al-Sikkah streets and dates the episode to approx. 11:00 on 13 Nov, saying charges detonated about 40 minutes later and further drops continued until evening.
bounded_discovery_context.uncertainty: Publication hour not verified; independent corroboration, exact number of displaced families, and full neighborhood damage assessment not confirmed.
bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Last batch of 12 additional targeted searches surfaced original PCHR report; primary page opened directly; older general civilian casualties excluded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only. The production Gaza collector/publisher remains authoritative. No schedule, approval, publication or production changes.
